name: TTK Prestige Limited
remarksWeb: 1. Promoter or Promoter Group  a. The Company informed the Stock Exchnages about the sudden demise of Mr. T T Venkatesh on September 17, 2025, belonging to the Promoter and Promoter Group of the Company.  Therefore, he ceased to be a part of the Promoter Group of the company in accordance with Regulation 31A (6) (c) of the SEBI LODR Regulations, 2015.   Further, transmission of his Shareholding to his Nominee has been completed and holdings is now shown in the name of Sarayu Thiruvallur Thattai (Duly represented by her mother and natural guardian Mrs. Maitri Gopalakrishna). Based on the declarations received from Ms. Sarayu Thiruvallur Thattai she is catagorized as Promoter Shareholder.  b. The Company informed the Stock Exchnages about the sudden demise of Mr. T T Jagannathan on Octover 09, 2025, belonging to the Promoter and Promoter Group of the Company.  Therefore, he ceased to be a part of the Promoter Group of the company in accordance with Regulation 31A (6) (c) of the SEBI LODR Regulations, 2015.   Further, transmission of his Shareholding to his Nominees has been completed and the holdings is now shown in the name of  Mr. Mukund Thiruvallur Thattai Mr. Thiruvallur Thatai Lakshman Ms. Sarayu Thiruvallur Thattai   All the above three are part of Promoter Shareholders.  2. ESOP related (Public Sharehoding)  We would like to clarify that the Company has allotted the Stock Options under Direct route under the Scheme-   TTK Prestige Limited - Long Term Incentive (Stock Option) Plan 2023.  Please note that the shares Alloted/Grated for Directors under ESOP scheme is shown under the Category  Directors and their relatives (excluding independent directors and nominee directors).  Similarly, for other Employees for whom the ESOP's are Alloted/Granted are shown under Category B Table III (4) (m)- Any other specify-ESOP or ESOS or ESPS.  3. SBO related  Due to demise of 2 partners of T T Krishnamachari & Co (Partnership Firm - Promoter) i.e., Mr. T T Jagannathan and Mr. T T Venkatesh, the Partnership deed has been re-constituted and there is change in profit sharing ratio of Partners. Therefore, the same is updated under the details of holding / exercise of rights in SBO sheet.
